subject: Sunspot Systems — request: temporary no-PO onboarding plan
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@sunspotsys.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
Cc: procure@sunspotsys.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: trial onboarding w/o PO?

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're trying to move a time-sensitive pilot forward (start-of-quarter cadence) and our finance policy is causing a bottleneck: our internal procurement requires a PO for all vendors, but the legal/commercial team at Sunspot is asking if Redwood can accept invoice-only for the first 30 days while we complete our internal PO approval.

Practical ask: can Redwood onboard Sunspot Systems into your vendor portal and accept invoice-only for the first month (invoices to be paid net 30) while we route the PO? If yes, what evidence or terms do you need from our side (insurance, W-9, purchase paperwork)?

I've attached: sunspot_onboarding_form.pdf (company details) and w9_sunspot.pdf.

Appreciate a quick read — decision impacts whether we can sign up for the November pilot.

Best,
Asha Menon
Head of Platform Partnerships
Sunspot Systems

Attachments:
- sunspot_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable onboarding form)
- w9_sunspot.pdf (tax form)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@sunspotsys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: trial onboarding w/o PO?

Asha — thanks for sending these over and for the clarity on timeline. We're excited about the pilot. Quick thoughts and a proposed path forward: 

1) Short answer: we can provision a temporary "invoice-only" onboarding for the pilot under a conditional addendum, not as a permanent policy change.

2) Requirements from our side to enable this:
 - Completed onboarding form (received)
 - W-9 (received)
 - Signed invoice-only addendum that limits the pilot to a single workspace and a spend cap of $25k.
 - Primary account owner identified and SSO set up (for audit/SCIM).

3) Timing and approvals: I'll need finance and procurement ops to approve the exception formally. Monica — tagging you for risk/scorecard and Marissa — for billing route and whether Treasury is comfortable with 30-day net on a temporary basis.

Proposed next steps:
 - Monica: can you run the vendor_scorecard and flag any deal-level financial controls we should add?
 - Marissa: if Treasury signs off on the spend cap and 30-day net, I'll route the addendum for signature (DocuSign).
 - Asha: if you can confirm the primary technical contact and expected pilot spend profile (weekly token estimates), that will speed review.

If all sounds good I'll prepare a one-page addendum and a limited provisioning ticket so the pilot can start within 48 hours of signatures.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

From: monica_patel@redwood.example.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: trial onboarding w/o PO?

Sergio / Marissa — I pulled Sunspot's registration details and ran our preliminary checks. High-level notes:

- Vendor scorecard attached (vendor_scorecard.xlsx). No negative alerts on sanctions or adverse media.
- Risk considerations: 1) no existing PO introduces a collections risk; 2) early-stage revenue history minimal — recommend spend cap; 3) ensure we have a signed addendum that includes indemnity language and a clawback if payment is late beyond agreed terms.

Recommendation: Approve conditional invoice-only onboarding for a single workspace with the following controls:
 - Spend cap: $25,000 total for 30 days
 - Payment terms: net 30 with auto-reminder at day 25 and escalation to collections at day 45
 - Require signed addendum and SSO provisioning before access is granted
 - Finance to bill to "Sunspot Systems" GL code 4201 for pilot-trials (Marissa please confirm routing)

If Marissa confirms Treasury is OK with net 30 under those controls I'll approve the exception.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head, Customer Ops & Onboarding | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.example.com

Attachments:
- vendor_scorecard.xlsx

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@sunspotsys.com>

We will provide SSO details to the technical contact (ankur.singh@sunspotsys.com) by end of day tomorrow.

Next steps on our side:
